name: claude-deck
description: Stream Deck + plugin for Claude Code desktop sessions: it hosts the bridge (claude-code/protocol/PROTOCOL.md), with a key and a dial for each session, session status and jump, approvals, saved prompts and mode

scripts.test: rm -rf build/test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-timeout=20000 --test-force-exit --test-reporter=spec build/test/test/*.test.js
